# BlockBuddies Offline v1.5.87

This release adds the Shadow Oracle outfit to character customization.

## Added

- Added a complete purple outfit inspired by the supplied character design.
- The set includes a dark crop top, open purple jacket with lavender trim,
  flared pleated skirt, purple eye mask, long dark hair, and purple boots.
- Added the Shadow Oracle Outfit to the Clothing > Tops catalog as an Epic
  customization set for 260 coins.
- Added matching catalog-card artwork and a full 3D avatar implementation.
- The outfit now renders consistently in customization previews, gameplay,
  vehicles, saved characters, and Local Party avatars.

## Android updates

- Uses the production package ID `com.blockbuddies.offline`.
- Retains the exact v1.5.79 update-signing identity so existing installations
  can update normally.

## Included files

- `BlockBuddies-Offline-v1.5.87.apk`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`
- `SIGNING-CERTIFICATE.txt`
- `APK-BADGING.txt`

## Validation

- Mobile customization visual verification at 576x1024
- ESLint and Oxlint
- TypeScript type checking
- Full Vitest unit and component suite
- Production web build
- Capacitor Android sync and release APK assembly
- Exact v1.5.79 signer-certificate check in GitHub Actions
- Production package-name and app-label checks in GitHub Actions
